title.zh: Mandelbrot 分形 · 无限放大
title.en: The Mandelbrot Set · Zoom Without End

desc.zh: 一行幼儿园算术 z→z²+c，反复按下去，能长出无限复杂的图形。拖动放大一千亿倍细节还在生长，每个点背后还藏着一整张朱利亚集。
desc.en: One line of schoolchild arithmetic, z → z² + c, pressed over and over, grows a picture of endless complexity. Drag to zoom a hundred billion times and the detail is still growing — and behind every point hides an entire Julia set.
